capabilities: Build a reading schedule from start date, target finish date and reading days
Track daily page or percent chunks and mark them complete
Redistribute remaining pages across remaining days when progress changes
Show a dashboard and sidebar of books with reading due today
Fill in book details from a note's properties
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or later; mobile support added in 1.3.0 and tested on Android. Deliberately avoids streaks, points and gamification.
problem: A target finish date and a page count give no daily plan, and static plans break as soon as you miss days or read more than planned.
summary: Reading scheduler that turns a book's target finish date and reading days into daily page or percent chunks and adjusts them to actual progress.
